in_hebrew.name: Estey

in_greek.name: Estey
in_greek.long_meaning: Estey είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'Astraia' meaning 'star'. In Greek mythology, Astraia was the goddess of the constellations and the guardian of justice and law.

in_latin.name: Estey
in_latin.long_meaning: Estey est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'Astraia' meaning 'star'. In Greek mythology, Astraia was the goddess of the constellations and the guardian of justice and law.
